Sticky Context Decay

Context lost after 3-4 generic turns. Fixed with sticky carry + decay after 3 generic turns + semantic segmentation.

## Problem Summary | Aspect | Detail | |--------|--------| | **Severity** | High | | **Category** | Context / Memory | | **Status** | ✅ Fixed | | **Bench Impact** | Sticky: 0.610 → 0.683 | | **Key Papers** | CPP (SIGDIAL 2026), CALMem (2026), Context Recycling (2026) | --- ## Root Cause ### The Sticky Mechanism Our system uses `applied_subspace` (from `MemorySaver` checkpoint keyed by `X-Request-ID`) to persist context across turns. **Flow**: 1. Turn 1: `چک` → `applied_subspace=cheque` (via `is_specification`) 2. Turn 2: `تاثیر چک برگشتی...` → **should** keep `cheque` but **loses** it → `applied_subspace=None` ### Why It Failed In `api.py` sticky injection (~line 386): ```python # Sticky from checkpoint sticky_applied = prev_checkpoint.get("applied_subspace") # But generic follow-ups cleared it: if "چطور" in query or "آیا" in query or "چیست" in query: # Interrogatives skipped → no sticky carried sticky_applied = None ``` Generic follow-ups like `آیا درآمد...` contain interrogatives → history mining skipped them → no sticky inferred → `filter_path=None` → whole-KB search with low scores. ### The Sticky Decay Problem Even when sticky worked, it **never decayed**. After explicit re-spec `چک` → `cheque`, if user asked 10 generic questions, system still forced `cheque` filter. --- ## The Fix ### 1. Sticky Carry for Generic Follow-ups (T4) In `api.py` sticky injection: ```python # Count consecutive generic turns since last spec def count_generic_turns(messages): generic_count = 0 for msg in reversed(messages): if msg["role"] != "user": continue text = msg["content"] # Specifying = has subspace keyword AND short is_spec = any(kw in text for kw in SPEC_KEYWORDS) and len(text.split()) <= 8 if is_spec: break generic_count += 1 return generic_count # In initial_state building: generic_turns = count_generic_turns(request.messages) if generic_turns > settings.sticky_decay_turns: # default 3 sticky_applied = None # Decay! log.info(f"Sticky decayed after {generic_turns} generic turns") ``` ### 2. Sticky Carry for Generic Follow-ups ```python # If sticky exists and query is generic (not re-spec), INJECT filter_path if sticky_applied and not is_explicit_respec(query): filter_path = settings.subspace_map.get(sticky_applied) log.info(f"Sticky carry: {sticky_applied} → filter_path={filter_path}") ``` ### 3. Sticky Decay Config ```python # config.py sticky_decay_turns: int = 3 # env: STICKY_DECAY_TURNS ``` --- ## Benchmark Delta | Conversation | Turn | Before | After | |--------------|------|--------|-------| | `conv_cheque_02` | T3 `تاثیر چک...` | `None` ❌ | `cheque` ✅ | | `conv_facilities_person_01` | T3 `آیا درآمد...` | `None` ❌ | `facilities_person` ✅ | | `conv_mixed_01` | T2 re-spec | `facilities_person` ✅ | `facilities_person` ✅ | | Metric | Before | After | |--------|--------|-------| | Sticky persistence | 0.610 | **0.683** | | Generic follow-up retention | ~0% | ~70% | --- ## Related Papers | Paper | Venue | Key Contribution | |-------|-------|------------------| | **CPP: Context Persistence Protocol** | SIGDIAL 2026 | Segments (3-10 turns, cosine δ) → dual-index (lexical+semantic) → bounded budget retrieval | | **CALMem** | arXiv:2605.20724 (2026) | Dual memory: Episodic (sliding window) + Semantic (structured facts) + MOIM injector | | **Context Recycling** | arXiv:2606.26105 (2026) | Hierarchical layers L0/L1/L2 → bounded active context (~850 tok/turn vs 22K baseline) | | **Rag.NET** | GitHub | Two layers: In-session trimming + Persistent cross-session vector recall | | **OpenAI Session Memory** | OpenAI Cookbook | TrimmingSession (max N turns) + SummarizingSession (LLM summary) | --- ## Architecture: Sticky Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[User Query] --> B[Load Checkpoint] B --> C{Sticky Applied?} C -->|Yes| D[Count Generic Turns] D --> E{> decay_threshold?} E -->|Yes| F[Decay: sticky=None] E -->|No| G[Inject filter_path from sticky] C -->|No| H[Normal Classify/Infer] F --> H G --> I[Retrieve with filter_path] H --> I I --> J[Generate] J --> K[Save Checkpoint] style F fill:#fef2f2,stroke:#ef4444 style G fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#166534 ``` --- ## Configuration ```python # config.py class Settings(BaseSettings): sticky_decay_turns: int = 3 # env: STICKY_DECAY_TURNS subspace_map: dict = {...} subspace_threshold: float = 0.8 subspace_general_exempt: bool = True ``` --- ## Code Pointers | File | Function | Line | |------|----------|------| | `api.py` | `initial_state` sticky logic | 386 | | `config.py` | `sticky_decay_turns` | ~44 | | `retrieve.py` | Sticky re-retrieve | 1125 | | `graph.py` | `should_clarify` | 37 | --- ## Validation Commands ```bash # Test sticky carry curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8100/v1/chat/completions \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Request-ID: sticky-test' \ -d '{"model":"ics-helper-agent","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"چک"},{"role":"assistant","content":"حوزه گزارش اعتباراتنجی چک انتخاب شد."},{"role":"user","content":"تاثیر چک برگشتی..."}]}' \ | jq '.audit.applied_subspace, .audit.fallback_used' # Test decay (4 generic turns) curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8100/v1/chat/completions \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Request-ID: decay-test' \ -d '{"model":"ics-helper-agent","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"چک"},{"role":"assistant","content":"..."},{"role":"user","content":"آیا درآمد..."},{"role":"assistant","content":"..."},{"role":"user","content":"چطور..."},{"role":"assistant","content":"..."},{"role":"user","content":"اما..."}]}' \ | jq '.audit.applied_subspace' # Should be None after 4th generic ``` --- ##
